name: 40514 · Lexington, KY
findings: ZIP 40514 (Lexington) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40514 (Lexington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 40514 (Lexington) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
